environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has three listener rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 5: forward /health to target group unconditionally, (2) Priority 10: a rule with conditions path-pattern=/api/* that routes through an associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with capacity 700. This rule group has two rules: Rule A (priority 1) is a rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP with action BLOCK. Rule B (priority 2) uses a regex-pattern-set match on query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|--|;|/\*|\*/|0x[0-9a-f])` with action BLOCK. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyNetworkEgress) that denies ec2:*, s3:*, and all network-related actions, and the task runs with a read-only root filesystem with /var/lib/app mounted as an ephemeral tmpfs volume.
